goal: Present your academic interest, motivation, preparation, and suitability in a personal but controlled way.

structure.instruction: State your academic interest and why it matters to you.
Explain how your studies developed your interest and ability.
Include projects, work, research, leadership, or volunteering if relevant.
Explain what shaped your interest in the field.
Show why this exact course and university support your goals.
Describe what you want to do after completing the course.

red_flags: Generic 'I love this subject' statements without proof
Repeating the same content from the SOP word-for-word
banned_phrases: I was born to do this
I just love it so much
I want to stay there permanently
this statement is just for the visa
quality_checklist: The tone is personal but formal
The statement shows development, not just desire
The university and course fit is specific
The writing is original and not copied from the SOP
The content is supported by the rest of the application
